report.summary: An incident occurred where account linking via the Account Aggregator failed starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00. The investigation established that the mTLS client certificate used by aa-connector to authenticate with aa-fiu-gateway expired at that exact timestamp, causing SSL handshakes to fail and error rates to spike on aa-connector and mobile-bff.

supporting.note: Shows the exact mTLS client certificate expiration time matching the onset.
Records SSL handshake failures due to expired certificate starting at 13:30:03.
Shows financial information fetch failing for consents due to upstream errors.
Error rate spiked upward at 13:30 due to synchronous dependency on aa-connector.

ranked_hypotheses.title: External aa-fiu-gateway Certificate Trust Store Rejection

supporting.note: SSL handshake failure with external gateway.

contradicting.note: Explicitly proves that the local client certificate expired at the exact onset time.

facts.text: The error rate for aa-connector began rising sharply at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00.
The error rate for mobile-bff spiked upward starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00.
mTLS client certificate CN=aa-connector.orange.internal expired at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z.
SSL handshake with aa-fiu-gateway failed due to the expired certificate starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:03+00:00.
Financial information fetch failed for consents due to upstream errors.
aa-connector depends synchronously on aa-fiu-gateway and user-db.
mobile-bff depends synchronously on aa-connector, auth-service, payments-api, portfolio-service, orders-service, and kyc-service.

assumptions: The automated certificate renewal process for aa-connector was either misconfigured or failed to execute prior to expiration.

timeline.event: aa-connector logged that the mTLS client certificate was set to expire in 0 days.
Symptom onset: error rate for aa-connector and mobile-bff spiked.
aa-connector began logging SSL handshake failures with aa-fiu-gateway due to the expired certificate.
Financial information fetch began failing for consents due to upstream errors.

recommended_actions.action: Immediately provision and deploy a valid mTLS client certificate for aa-connector to restore secure communication with aa-fiu-gateway.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly resolves the expired certificate causing SSL handshake failures and account linking errors.

recommended_actions.action: Implement monitoring and alerting for mTLS and TLS certificate expirations well in advance of the 0-day warning threshold.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future outages caused by silently expiring client certificates.
